column1: # Tests of LiteDB.Tests that pass under the JIT but fail when the suite runs as a Native AOT binary.
# scripts/validate-aot-test-suite.sh fails on any such test that is not listed here.
# Format: category<TAB>test name. Theory rows are numbered in declaration order.
# assertion-library             FluentAssertions or xunit builds generic code at run time (BeEquivalentTo, collection
#                               trackers, comparers). The assertion fails to run; LiteDB is not involved.
# test-uses-dynamic-code        The test itself emits a type with Reflection.Emit.
# test-uses-private-reflection  The test reflects over private LiteDB members that trimming removes, or closes a
#                               generic LiteDB method over a type by reflection.
# runtime-mapper                Reflection-based entity mapping constructs closed generic collection types, or
#                               System.Index, at run time. These APIs carry RequiresDynamicCode and are outside the
#                               Native AOT contract (docs/AOT.md); source-generated collections replace them.
